name: nava-presentation-studio
description: Build product presentations with evidence-led slides and locally recorded demos included.

interface.shortDescription: Create slides with polished product demos included.
interface.longDescription: Connects Nava storycraft with a local slide generator and product demo studio. Produces an editable PowerPoint, a browser presentation with video, PDF, and a portable sharing package.
defaultPrompt: Use $nava-presentation-studio to create a product presentation with a polished demo included.
